@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@ parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()

# CLI Tool

Run the tool with `--timeout-secs 30` to configure the connection timeout.

The default value is 30 seconds.

description_for_judges: The CLI flag `--timeout-secs` was renamed to `--timeout` in the code, but the README still tells users to use the old flag name. The system detects this exact sentence and links it to the responsible code line.
